mutants.label: Network6/FBAnd24.AndIn2 (NOT in_False_SI2_CH8) deactivated
mutants.previous: EQUIVALENT-by-proof, conditional on GRP-2 (DERIVED Symbol same-cycle visibility)
proof: CONST (primary, new): Q-MU06-01 B fixes in_False_SI2_CH8 = FALSE. FBAnd24 active operands in F1: AndIn1 b_ResetPB_Lock, AndIn2 NOT in_False_SI2_CH8, AndIn3 linkRndGreenQualified (others Deactivated). With in_False=FALSE the operand NOT in_False is TRUE in every scan, the neutral element of AND; deactivating it yields the same Boolean function of the remaining operands in every scan, independent of execution order, Symbol timing or history. Executed check: repro/mu06-constant-check.mjs on the parsed canonical block, 4/4 rows with in_False=FALSE identical (F1 vs MU06), the only differing row has in_False=TRUE (out of scope per Q-MU06-01).
GRP-1/GRP-2 (previous argument) is no longer required for equivalence within the declared input domain; it is retained only as history.
conditions: Input domain: in_False_SI2_CH8 constant FALSE (Q-MU06-01 B). If a later decision removes/replaces this technical input or allows TRUE, re-evaluate.
FBAnd24 is an AND block with the operand set listed above (canonical F1 SHA pinned).
reevaluateWhen: any change of in_False_SI2_CH8 role or of Network6/FBAnd24 operands

mutants.previous: killed on component boundary; reachable kill conditional on Q-MU06-01
mutants.classification: KILLED by requirement-based behavioural test on the full program, reachable, in_False constant FALSE
mutants.answerToLead: Not equivalent. The in_False pulse is no longer used (out of input domain). Another reachable distinguisher exists in Safe: a button held across a cover open/close (in_InterLock_NC_1 or _2 FALSE 300 ms, Safe kept, b_EStop_Ok kept), then released; a new attempt after 1999 ms of release is rejected by F1 and accepted by MU24 (BOTH -> out_LV_C1/b_Step12; BLUE -> out_Door_Unlock_Solonoeid). After 2001 ms both accept (positive control).
mutants.oracle: SCENARIO_DECISIONS items 9 and 11: a new attempt requires 2 s of continuous release of both buttons; the pause is not counted while a button is still held. Release starts at button release (after the cover is already closed), so 1999 ms < 2 s -> attempt must not be accepted; 2001 ms -> accepted. The oracle does not depend on the cover event itself.

killer.MU24: 8/16 fail - exactly the eight 1999 ms (q-1) cases: {green,blue} held x {in_InterLock_NC_1,in_InterLock_NC_2} x {BOTH,BLUE}; the eight 2001 ms (q+1) cases pass (mu24-reachable-kill.MU24.tap sha256 3a339d198647353caed6ee63fb39140500dfb9882ff87b4fb7c9d7cc9aa8d7bd)
killer.notInRegressionYet: The killer lives in the tester folder, not in SafetyTests/test/, and is not run by npm run check:software. Recommend adopting it as SafetyTests/test/current-<slice>-release-filter-*.test.js (owner per lead).
